overview: VYAN Netra is a master admin console for managing all VYAN products, apps, and platforms from a single command center.
features: Register and link external VYAN apps using a secure 6-digit alphanumeric app code
Automatic X-App-Code header injection on every request to a linked app
Live connection status per linked app with error detection
Graceful 'Connection Refused' error display on unauthorized API access
Debounced fetch controls to prevent runaway API calls
Dynamic routing to each app's registered Vercel API URL
Dark void theme with cosmic glassmorphism and nano-particle animation
